## Communication {.unnumbered #communication}

**Outbound.**
I will send official class announcements through Canvas Announcements.
Please set Canvas to notify you of them right away,
so you do not miss important information:
in the course's Canvas notification settings,
set the **Announcement** row's **Email** column to **Notify immediately**.

**Inbound.**
All course-related correspondence goes through Canvas.
Post nearly all questions and comments for me or the TAs
on the class discussion forum, Canvas Discussions (link **TBD**).
Anything that should not be posted there, such as a grading question or objection,
goes in a Canvas message to me.

Confidential matters, such as information about your health,
also go in a Canvas message to me, not to my email.

## Questions and Corrections {.unnumbered}

If something in the course materials seems wrong, ask.
The course materials include the notes, worksheets, assignments,
and anything I say or show in class, including my slides.
I will make mistakes, and so will the other authors of the materials.

Do not assume that you are the confused one when the material might be wrong.
Ask your question first, in class or outside it,
and we can talk through your reasoning together.
If you are right, we all learn something and I fix the material.
If you are not, we can jointly find out where the confusion started.

## Health Precautions {.unnumbered}

If you are sick with something that could be communicable,
let me know ahead of time and I will try to arrange a way for you to keep up,
so you can stay home and not expose others needlessly.
Please contact me if you have questions, concerns, or suggestions.

## Software {.unnumbered #software}

The labs and the programming parts of homework use [Racket](https://racket-lang.org/),
a functional programming language.
Racket is free, and it comes with the DrRacket editor.
For any software that comes pre-installed in the department labs,
please use the default installed version.
